unlisted_practices: Morphology-anchored instruction tuning and reinforcement learning (MAVIC) to enforce consistency between visual observations and diagnostic conclusions
Confidence-consistency test-time adaptation (CCT) at inference for robust predictions

screen.reason: The paper introduces a dataset (DermoInstruct), a benchmark (DermoBench evaluating morphology, diagnosis, reasoning, and fairness), and a multimodal LLM (DermoGPT). While fairness and consistency are evaluated on benchmark datasets, it does not evaluate an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
